timing: Recorded after the pilot and recovered H1-only results; exploratory, not a preregistration

primary.selection: First stored checkpoint reaching the target; report actual loss and step
primary.replicate_unit: Training seed; preserve paired gamma observations
primary.nonconvergence: Retain all requested outcomes; exclude unreached risks from matched-risk contrasts with counts

interpretation: Analyze geometry, margins, decoding and PH separately. No threshold is selected to force a transition or nuisance-loss claim. Exact polygon certificates have a separate restricted domain. CIFAR supports geometry claims only.
freeze_policy: All requested training outcomes, required metric files, dataset validation, exact certificate replay, and Lean audit must pass before final analysis and paper generation.
